Results.ReviewText: Took a little longer to put together than I had expected but the fit and finish on all of the parts were extremely good. This is the fourth Weber grill that I have purchased - the last one was a little larger model that I gave to the buyer of my house.  It was over 12 years old and I was concerned about moving it.  I have had the grill for a month and have cooked on it at least three times a week.  I've tried seafood, steak, burgers, chicken and pizza and all of the meals have turned out much better than expected, especially since I am just getting use to how the grill cooks.  Highly recommended and well worth the price.

Results.ReviewText:
When our 17-year-old Weber grill’s framework rusted out from sitting in the elements . . . we replaced it with a wood-pellet grill.   After only a few uses, both my wife & I realized we were unsatisfied in the way ‘grilled’ items came off the wood-fired ‘oven.    There was no way to have direct and indirect cooking surfaces . . . there were no char marks . . . nor could one not cook with a rotisserie on it.   We came to the realization the wood-pellet ‘oven’ was simply not a true ‘grill!’
The decision was made to sell the wood-fired ‘oven’ and replace it with another three-burner Weber grill.   The Spirit E-310 fit the bill . . . and the nice thing is this grill has the burners oriented front to back, rather than side to side as the old grill had been.  This allows for both direct and indirect cooking surfaces easier . . . and the controls are up front and good-sized to control the burners.
We are totally satisfied with our new Weber grill and counsel everyone considering going with the ‘hype’ of wood-pellet grills to think long and hard before giving up the results which come off a Weber grill instead of an outdoor oven!
Results.Title: No Match For A Wood-Pellet Oven

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased the 3 burner Weber grill and it's my best purchase in a long time. I am cooking on it nearly every night and the food is coming out delicious. I love the 3 burners so I have choices on how much heat. I love the thermostat so I can cook at the exact temperature I need to, and the options of 1-3 burners easily gives me the temperature I want. The other incredible thing is the Weber App!! By far this has improved my cooking immensely. I click on grilling, chose the meat I am cooking, I choose the thickness and how I want it done, medium, med rare, etc. The app tells me what temperature to use and the number of minutes to cook it. I used to over or undercook steak and now steak and all other meats are done to perfection just by following the instructions on the app. The app is free when you register your grill online. I absolutely recommend both the grill and the app!
Results.Title: Love this grill
